errors.text_span: 最短的直方条的频次约为50
errors.evidence: The shortest bars in the histogram, corresponding to high overlap ratios (e.g., > 0.9), have frequencies significantly lower than 50. For instance, the last bar is closer to a frequency of 10-20. A frequency of 50 corresponds to the bar at an overlap ratio of approximately 0.75, which is not the shortest.

errors.text_span: 最长的直方条的频次约为1750
errors.evidence: The peak of the longest bar is visibly above the 1750 tick mark on the y-axis. The actual maximum frequency is closer to 1800.

errors.text_span: 直方条的高度随着重叠率的增加而总体呈下降趋势
errors.evidence: This statement over-generalizes the trend. The distribution is right-skewed; the frequency first increases to a peak at a low overlap ratio (around 0.15-0.2) and then decreases. It does not show a simple overall downward trend from the beginning.
